sloka: राक्षसांस्तर्पयिष्यामि हरीणां मांसशोणितैः ।रामलक्ष्मणयोश्चापि स्वयं पास्यामि शोणितम् ।। ६.६०.८१ ।।।।
transliteration: rākṣasāṁstarpayiṣyāmi harīṇāṁ māṁsaśoṇitaiḥ ।rāmalakṣmaṇayoścāpi svayaṁ pāsyāmi śoṇitam ।। 6.60.81 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Mighty Armed One! You hear from Ravana the advantages and disadvantages and thereafter assess the enemy to conquer."
